notes: This taxonomy is diagnostic and does not rescore the frozen final benchmark.
Cases district_spokesman_004 and conference_026 were experimentally confirmed as question/gold-SQL mismatches.
Cases conference_023 and vehicle_rent_028 were experimentally confirmed as semantic-review regressions.
Case district_spokesman_009 differs by cross-engine numeric type/precision representation with absolute Decimal difference 7E-16.
Cases art_1_112 and cre_Students_Information_Systems_003 are retained as semantic ambiguities rather than asserted benchmark defects.

phase8_final_pilot_1_032.reason: Unjustified DISTINCT changed the required count/cardinality.

phase8_final_book_review_004.reason: Aggregation scope mismatch: generated per-book grouping instead of the benchmark global max/min result.

phase8_final_conference_037.reason: Incorrect join/filter semantics changed participant counts.

phase8_final_conference_039.reason: Grouped by conference name instead of conference instance/id, merging distinct conferences.

phase8_final_government_shift_010.reason: Used the wrong relationship/table despite the required tables being retrieved.

phase8_final_government_shift_015.reason: Added an unsupported extra NOT EXISTS constraint and over-filtered the result.

phase8_final_pilot_1_057.reason: Correct grouped values but output columns were returned in the wrong order.

phase8_final_boat_1_019.reason: Returned only the sailor name while the reference result also required the sailor id.

phase8_final_vehicle_driver_005.reason: Correct values but projected driver id and count in the opposite order.

phase8_final_art_1_049.reason: Correct groups but location and count columns were returned in the opposite order.

phase8_final_vehicle_rent_036.reason: Returned an extra aggregate column in addition to the required vehicle name.

phase8_final_customers_and_orders_026.reason: Used SELECT * instead of returning only the requested product name.

phase8_final_online_exams_004.reason: Correct filter but exam name/date columns were returned in the opposite order.

phase8_final_cre_Students_Information_Sy.reason: Teacher id and count were returned in the opposite order; semantic review did not repair the mismatch.

phase8_final_district_spokesman_004.reason: Confirmed gold-SQL mismatch: question asks for the population sum of the top-3-area districts; QueryPilot produced 19607 while gold SQL aggregated all districts to 22531.

phase8_final_art_1_112.reason: Semantic scope ambiguity: gold uses row-level non-canvas filtering while QueryPilot interprets 'no work with medium on canvas' at location level.

phase8_final_conference_026.reason: Confirmed gold-SQL mismatch: question specifies United States staff but gold SQL omits the nationality filter.

phase8_final_cre_Students_Information_Sy.reason: Zero-count ambiguity: QueryPilot treats zero detentions as less than two; the reference inner join excludes students with no detention rows.

phase8_final_conference_023.reason: Confirmed regression: original generated SQL was correct; semantic review added LIMIT 1 and made the final result incorrect.

phase8_final_vehicle_rent_028.reason: Confirmed regression: original SQL matched the reference; semantic review changed join semantics and introduced an extra zero-rental vehicle.

phase8_final_district_spokesman_009.reason: Equivalent AVG computation differed across SQLite/PostgreSQL representation by 7E-16 and by stored type (float versus string).
